title: Hostile Valkyries fans verbally attacked women's sports activists at WNBA Finals Game 1 in San Francisco
description: Video shows liberal WNBA fans cursing at Jennifer Sey's group for wearing XX-XY Athletics shirts at Valkyries Finals Game 1 in San Francisco.

title: Blaze at St Petersburg oil sites as Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia
description: A Ukrainian attack using over 1,000 drones set an oil terminal ablaze in St. Petersburg, Russia, killing one person and injuring five others.

title: Zacharia oust raises question about importance of the White House press secretary
description: President Donald Trump’s abrupt decision to part ways with White House press secretary Katie Zacharia less than a week after appointing her has raised questions about the importance of the position in an administration where the president frequently acts as his own spokesman. Zacharia’s departure Friday followed a rocky debut behind the White House podium […]
